name: SimpleDRM
author: Javier

sections.description:
SimpleDRM enables you to sell DRM-protected media from your Woocommerce shop. Just install the plugin, register at https://plazadrm.cm and start selling.

Very much like Amazon Kindle or iTunes, when your customers buy digital goods at your shop, the contents become available at the Plaza Reader app. The reader is a free app for Android and iOS equipped with DRM protection, that is, the customers cannot download or copy your media. We will charge you an extremely reduced fee for the use of the Reader by your customers (less than 0,50 USD per customer, one-off).

The Reader is designed to provide access to all the shops installing the plugin, so that the user experiences all the media in one place.

To protect your media, the Reader uses AES-256 encryption. Check all the security features at https://plazadrm.com/security. Regarding privacy, we will not host or have access to your media files. We will not handle sensitive data like your customers passwords.

Additional Documentation

You can find more information about Simple DRM” plugin at this page
sections.installation:
Installation procedure:

  1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/simple-drm directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress. No setup needed at this time.
  3. Register your shop at https://plazadrm.com, which is the app server controlling the Reader app. Detailed installation instructions are available at https://plazadrm.com/setup.

The whole process should not take more than 10-15 minutes. Right after registration, you will be able to test the app with your own products. The plugin can be easily uninstalled if needed, do not hesitate to give it a try.
sections.faq:
What is the cost?

The plugin is free and the app is free (with no ads). We will charge you an amount starting at 10 cents per customer using the app, independently of the number of items they purchase. The first 10 users are free, so that you can try the system at no cost.

Will you have access to our items?

Not at all. The media is downloaded encrypted from your shop directly into the Reader app. Our servers do not handle the media, nor sensitive information like passwords.

What if my customers use Apple?

The iOS version will soon be availabe. Check it at https://plazadrm.com/apps.

What kind of digital media can I sell?

Currently, we handle epub and pdf formats for ebooks, and mp4 for video.
